{{Top|leg}}
'''''Atrivis''''' was a group of three [[Cargo ferry|cargo ferries]] employed by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="XWvTF:BoP">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter: Balance of Power]]''</ref>

==Hisrory==
The ''Atrivis'' cargo ferries were part of a convoy, consisting of [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvettes]] [[Python (corvette group)|''Python'']], cargo ferries [[Athega (cargo ferry group)|''Athega'']] and the [[Ton-Falk-class escort carrier|escort carrier]] [[Gallant (escort carrier)|''Gallant'']] that were carrying [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing starfighters]]. These fighters were needed to muster the Rebel forces against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Task Force Vengeance/Legends|Task Force ''Vengeance'']]. While being escorted by [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] from [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] and [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold Squadron]], the convoy was [[Battle of Halbara/Legends|attacked]] by Imperial [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]] in the [[Halbara system/Legends|Halbara system]], followed soon afterwards by [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Nebulon-B frigate]] ''[[Damocles]]'' and [[Nebulon-B2 frigate|modified frigate]] [[Lightning (Nebulon-B2 frigate)|''Lightning'']]. Despite outnumbering the Rebel X-wings, their skills prevailed against the Imperial pilots and the convoy managed to escape into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].<ref name="XWvTF:BoP" />
